version.title: Version Management

help.title: How It Works
help.applyBody: : sets this version's configuration as the current version.
help.deleteBody: : only historical versions can be deleted, and the action cannot be undone.
help.viewBody: : preview the configuration details and change notes.

version.applySuccess: Version {version} applied successfully! The configuration has been updated and is now active.

applyDialog.title: Apply Config Version
applyDialog.heading: Version Apply Confirmation
applyDialog.warning: Applying this version will replace the current configuration. Please make sure everything is correct.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Config Version
deleteDialog.heading: Version Delete Confirmation
deleteDialog.warning: Warning: this action cannot be undone!
deleteDialog.hint: Deleting this version will permanently remove its configuration data. Please confirm you no longer need this version.

cannotDelete.title: Delete Failed
cannotDelete.heading: The Current Version Cannot Be Deleted
cannotDelete.message: Version {version} is currently in use and cannot be deleted.

errorDialog.title: Version Apply Failed
errorDialog.advice2: 2. Make sure the network connection is normal
errorDialog.advice3: 3. If the issue persists, contact the system administrator

errors.versionNotFound: Version {version} does not exist or has been deleted
errors.configCorrupt: The configuration file of version {version} is corrupted and cannot be applied
errors.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to perform this action
errors.systemError: Internal system error, please try again later
